name: Codebreaker Starter Deck
extDescription:
Starter Deck: Codebreaker introduces the basics of Dueling with cards that are strong and easy to understand. New Duelists can learn the basics of Link Summoning using "Code Talker" Link Monsters, then use this Starter Deck as a base to build their own unique Deck by collecting Cyberse monsters and "Code Talker" Link Monsters from many different releases including Structure Deck: Cyberse Link and Extreme Force. To ensure Duelists have the tools necessary to ramp up those basic techniques and take Link Summoning to the next level, Starter Deck: Codebreaker includes powerful additions like Linkuriboh, previously unreleased in Latin American and European territories!

Link Monsters are the newest addition to the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME! They offer Duelists a brand-new outlet to demonstrate their skills by mastering not just how they play their cards, but where they play them as well. These new monsters have become an integral part of Dueling, and Starter Deck: Codebreaker contains 5 Link Monsters to give new Duelists a leg up in competition.

Starter Deck: Codebreaker contains 45 cards:
• 2 Ultra Rares
• 3 Super Rares
• 40 Commons

name: Leotron
extDescription: A territorial electronic monster that guards its own domain.

name: Texchanger
extDescription: Once per turn, when your monster is targeted for an attack: You can negate the attack, then Special Summon 1 Cyberse Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Widget Kid
extDescription: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Cyberse monster from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Widget Kid" once per turn.

name: Cyberse White Hat
extDescription: If you control 2 or more monsters with the same Type, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Cyberse White Hat" once per turn this way. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: You can make all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Bitron
extDescription: A new species found in electronic space. There's not much information on it.

name: RAM Clouder
extDescription: You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "RAM Clouder" once per turn.

name: Linkslayer
extDescription: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can discard up to 2 cards, then target that many Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

name: Backup Secretary
extDescription: If you control a Cyberse monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Backup Secretary" once per turn this way.

name: Launcher Commander
extDescription: All other Cyberse monsters you control gain 300 ATK/DEF. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Cyberse monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: Cliant
extDescription: While this Normal Summoned/Set card is face-up on the field, all Cyberse monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF during your turn only. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Cyberse monster in your hand or face-up field instead.

name: Bitrooper
extDescription: You can send 1 Level 2 or lower monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Bitrooper" once per turn.

name: Flamvell Guard
extDescription: A Flamvell guardian who commands fire with his will. His magma-hot barrier protects his troops from intruders.

name: Beast King Barbaros
extDescription: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1900. You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Cyber Dragon
extDescription: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

name: Exarion Universe
extDescription: During your Battle Step, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: You can make this card lose exactly 400 ATK, and if it does, it will inflict piercing battle damage. These effects last until the end of this turn.

name: Evilswarm Mandragora
extDescription: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

name: Marshmallon
extDescription: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After damage calculation, if this card was attacked, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: The attacking player takes 1000 damage.

name: Ryko, Lightsworn Hunter
extDescription:
FLIP: Apply these effects (simultaneously).
• You can destroy 1 card on the field.
• Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the GY.

name: Battle Fader
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then end the Battle Phase. If Summoned this way, banish it when it leaves the field.

name: Swift Scarecrow
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

name: Cynet Recovery
extDescription: If a Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can target 1 monster in your GY, except a Link Monster; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Cynet Recovery" once per turn.

name: Cynet Universe
extDescription: All Link Monsters you control gain 300 ATK. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in the GY; shuffle it into the Deck. If this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: Send all monsters in the Extra Monster Zones to the GY.

name: Scapegoat
extDescription: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

name: Monster Reborn
extDescription: Target 1 monster in either player's GY; Special Summon it.

name: Dark Hole
extDescription: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Book of Moon
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field, change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: United We Stand
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK/DEF for each face-up monster you control.

name: Card Trader
extDescription: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck; draw 1 card.

name: Burden of the Mighty
extDescription: Each face-up monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK x its own Level.

name: Ego Boost
extDescription: When a monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

name: Supply Squad
extDescription: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Draw a card.

name: Cynet Regression
extDescription: If you Special Summon a Link Monster(s): Target 1 card on the field; destroy it, then draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Cynet Regression" per turn.

name: Shadow Spell
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Mirror Force
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

name: Zero Gravity
extDescription: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on the field.

name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
extDescription: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

name: Transcode Talker
extDescription:
2+ Effect Monsters
When this card is co-linked, it and its co-linked monsters gain 500 ATK, also your opponent cannot target any of them with card effects. You can target 1 Link-3 or lower Cyberse Link Monster in your GY, except "Transcode Talker": Special Summon it to your zone this card points to. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this effect, except Cyberse monsters. You can only use this effect of "Transcode Talker" once per turn.

name: Pentestag
extDescription:
2 Effect Monsters
If your linked monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Decode Talker
extDescription:
2+ Effect Monsters
Gains 500 ATK for each monster it points to. When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets a card(s) you control (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Link Spider
extDescription:
1 Normal Monster
Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand to your zone this card points to.

name: Linkuriboh
extDescription:
1 Level 1 Monster
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Tribute this card; change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0, until the end of this turn. If this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Level 1 monster; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Linkuriboh" once per turn.
